extensions.heading: Major Planetary Cycles in Financial Astrology

records.raw_text: - **Stocks**: Jupiter cycles favor growth sectors; Saturn cycles emphasize value and defensives. Use for quarterly/annual portfolio reviews. - **Crypto**: Highly sensitive to Uranus/Jupiter aspects due to its innovative, speculative nature. - **Commodities/Currencies**: Mars and Venus cycles influence shorter moves; outer planet cycles for secular trends. - **Personal Finance**: Progressed charts and transits to personal financial houses indicate optimal timing for major decisions (investing, debt management, retirement planning).
